scope: Public vendor documentation, community leads, external WCAG guidance, pinned Flutter source text and Git tree. No runtime inspection.

patterns.title: Scroll overflow edge fading
patterns.documented_behavior: Official Flutter source computes separate fades from hidden content before/after the viewport; supports horizontal and vertical axes. Default threshold 50 logical units, fade proportion capped at half the viewport. No fade when no content hidden on that edge. Optional animation duration; linear default curve, no animation when duration omitted.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test scroll positions, resizing, no overflow, high contrast, reduced motion, focus and visible scrollbar; don't assume web or production app uses these values.
patterns.evidence_status: pinned source inspected; runtime not executed

patterns.title: Context-sensitive keyboard shortcuts
patterns.documented_behavior: Global shortcuts configurable and initially disabled. Editor and task contexts have different bindings; navigation, closing and inbox commands documented. Docs support moving a block and converting selected text to a task or comment.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test input focus, shortcut conflicts, discoverability, platform mapping and ability to perform all actions without shortcut.

patterns.title: Persistent high-contrast disclosure indicator
patterns.documented_behavior: Vendor documents a persistent background treatment for toggle-list chevrons in authenticated Docs; hover supplements visibility. Scope excludes public and several embedded surfaces.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test actual resting/hover/focus appearance, contrast, accessible expanded state and all excluded surfaces separately.

patterns.title: Non-drag pointer and keyboard alternatives
patterns.documented_behavior: External WCAG criterion requires a single-pointer alternative for nonessential drag functionality. Keyboard accessibility is separate. Proposed for sortable tabs, cards and panels, not a confirmed ClickUp feature.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test click/tap move menu, keyboard reorder, cancel, focus restoration and result announcement.
patterns.evidence_status: external standard and proposed QA; no ClickUp conformance claim

patterns.title: Focus visibility with overlays
patterns.documented_behavior: External minimum criterion requires focused controls not fully hidden by author content; sticky headers/footers and nonmodal overlays are relevant.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test sidebar popover, tab strip, sticky answer toolbar, toast and modal; verify focus indicator independently.
patterns.evidence_status: external standard and proposed QA; no runtime observation

patterns.title: Minimum pointer targets in dense workspace
patterns.documented_behavior: External WCAG criterion specifies 24 by 24 CSS pixels or qualifying exceptions/spacing. Icon glyph size differs from clickable target.
patterns.proposed_qa: Measure hit areas rather than glyphs; verify close, more, checkbox, resize controls and mobile alternative.

patterns.title: Reflow versus two-dimensional work surfaces
patterns.documented_behavior: External WCAG criterion covers reflow at 320 CSS px width for vertical reading, with exceptions for content requiring two-dimensional layout.
patterns.proposed_qa: Test question reader, notes, sidebar controls and dialog at 320 CSS px, 400% zoom; isolate table/graph exceptions and maintain reachable controls.

patterns.title: Form accessibility risk and validation
patterns.documented_behavior: Community reports describe inaccessible answer options, CAPTCHA and scrollbars; vendor acknowledges ongoing accessibility work. Reports not independently reproduced.
patterns.proposed_qa: Use native radio grouping, accessible names and error announcements, keyboard navigation, visible overflow, accessible alternatives to CAPTCHA and manual screen reader tests.
